fields.description: Saadiyat Lagoons is Aldar’s family-villa community on the eastern side of Saadiyat Island. The original collection offers four-to-six-bedroom homes beside a mangrove landscape, with residential clusters, parks and planned community services. Later releases need their own availability and completion checks.

overview: The original launch offered cool and warm interior palettes with standard or premium finishes. The community is planned in residential clusters, combining family homes with landscape, recreation and day-to-day services. A garden pod was offered as an optional way to add a separate home office or majlis.
research.locationNote: Aldar places the community on the eastern side of Saadiyat Island, close to mangroves and connected with the island’s wider cultural, educational and leisure destinations. It is a master community with several releases, so the exact neighbourhood and plot matter.
research.priceNote: The first release was advertised from AED 6.1m for sales beginning November 2022. Later phases and resale homes have different prices; this historical reference does not confirm available stock.
research.paymentNote: Shown below is the reported original 40/60 option. Oia also lists a 60/40 option comprising 10% booking, 50% construction and 40% handover. Eligibility and dates depend on the release and contract.
research.handoverNote: FY2025 pipeline: 2026. Original launch handovers were expected to start in early Q2 2026. Bayut lists later Al Sidr timing as Q3 2027; confirm the selected phase rather than assuming the entire community is delivered.

facts.label: Options are not inclusions
facts.value: The official villa drawings show provision for a pool, garden pod and lift. Their disclaimer states these are additional items excluded from the initial price. Confirm contracted upgrades before treating them as supplied features.

facts.label: First-release eligibility
facts.value: The October 2022 release was announced for UAE nationals. Do not assume the same eligibility or ownership terms apply to every later release or resale; check the exact title and purchase requirements.
